day_shape: 75 items: IRGC drones toward Bahrain shot down by US forces, tanker explosions in Strait of Hormuz claimed by IRGC Navy, IAEA flags uninspected Isfahan enrichment plant, three OFAC/White House Iran actions, heavy Khamenei Fatima mourning cycle.

threads.label: IRGC drones intercepted over Bahrain
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces shot down two IRGC one-way attack drones launched toward Bahrain, with no damage or injuries, rejecting an IRGC claim of hitting a US early-warning radar. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he had moved to a military base and would not be cowed by Iranian death threats.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker explosions
threads.summary: The IRGC Navy said two tankers that had switched off tracking struck a naval mine and caught fire south of the Strait of Hormuz, with Jerusalem Post reporting an LNG carrier among them. Hormozgan provincial authorities said no strikes had been reported in the province by 22:25 local time, and the UN Security Council met at Bahrain's request on Gulf maritime security.

threads.label: IAEA concern over Isfahan enrichment plant
threads.summary: A report seen by Reuters said the IAEA does not know the exact location of Iran's newest declared enrichment plant near Isfahan or whether it contains nuclear material, more than a year after Tehran declared it. The Jerusalem Post reported the watchdog as "increasingly concerned" that Iran has not allowed inspection of the underground facility.

threads.label: US sanctions and NDAA determination
threads.summary: OFAC published Iran-related General Licenses EE, FF and W in the Federal Register, and the White House issued a Presidential Determination under Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the FY2012 NDAA on Iranian oil-trade sanctions. All four documents were dated 13 November.

threads.label: UK Iran International spying convictions fallout
threads.summary: UK counterterrorism police said the men convicted of spying on Iran International journalists in London worked from files sent from Iran listing targets' photos, workplaces, cars and pets, some gathered via ChatGPT. The Committee to Protect Journalists and Nobel laureate Shirin Ebadi said the verdicts do not end the threat to exiled Iranian journalists.

threads.label: Khamenei Fatima al-Zahra mourning cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted repeatedly from the evening mourning ceremony for Lady Fatima al-Zahra at Zainabiyyah, including recitations by Mahmoud Karimi, Javad Haidari and Mithaq Moatei. One post said "America suffered a great defeat from the Resistance front" and IRIB echoed with commentary that America is a "paper tiger."

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and US Navy visit
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said more than 10 operatives were killed in Gaza strikes over the past week, including two Hamas members who crossed into Israel on 7 October 2023, and that a weapons workshop was dismantled. US 5th Fleet commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw concluded a visit to Israeli Navy chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel, and Mossad chief Roman Gofman travelled to Washington to meet CIA Director John Ratcliffe.

events.summary:
Unauthorized drone activity at RAF Lakenheath base in the UK forced US military personnel to seek shelter. The USAF moved at least two aircraft to the base following a reported Iranian threat to RAF bases in Fairfield and Mildenhall, where they were previously located.

events.title_en: Explosion and fire aboard two illegal tankers south of the Strait of Hormuz, Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy
events.summary_en: Explosion and fire aboard two illegal tankers south of the Strait of Hormuz. Hours ago, two tankers that had switched off their radar and positioning systems and were attempting to pass through an unauthorised route in the Strait of Hormuz struck a naval mine, exploded and caught fire. The flames from one of the two vessels, which was a supertanker, lit up the southern shores of the Strait of Hormuz at night. The IRGC Navy warns ship owners and shipping companies that passage through the Strait of Hormuz without coordination with the IRGC Navy's traffic control centre in the Strait of Hormuz and disregarding Iranian arrangements for this strait will have such consequences.

events.title_en: 85 Saudi airstrikes and missile strikes on Yemen in the past 24 hours
events.summary_en: 85 Saudi airstrikes and missile strikes on Yemen in the past 24 hours. Yemen's Armed Forces spokesman announced on Friday that Saudi fighter jets have carried out 85 airstrikes and missile strikes in the past 24 hours, targeting civilian areas in Lahj, Taiz, Saada, Jouf, Marib and Amran provinces. These strikes were carried out using F-15 and Typhoon fighters that took off from Khamis Mushait and Taif bases. Missile strikes were also launched from the Najran region. The total number of Saudi airstrikes and missile strikes since the escalation of tensions against Yemen has reached 4,948.

events.title_en: Held with the presence of those devoted to Fatima and on behalf of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution; Evening mourning ceremony marking the martyrdom of Lady Fatima al-Zahra, may God's peace and blessings be upon her, at Zainabiyyah
events.summary_en: Held with the presence of those devoted to Fatima and on behalf of the Leader of the Islamic Revolution; Evening mourning ceremony marking the martyrdom of Lady Fatima al-Zahra, may God's peace and blessings be upon her, at Zainabiyyah. The mourning and lamentation ceremony for the evening of the martyrdom of Lady Fatima al-Zahra, may God's peace and blessings be upon her, this evening (Friday, 22 Aban 1405) was held after the Maghrib and Isha prayers with the presence of various segments of the people and honoured families of the martyrs near the place of the celestial ascension of the great martyr of Iran. At the beginning of this ceremony, which is presided over by His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, the Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Javad Haidari, while seeking intercession through the sacred shrine of the Master of the Age, may God hasten his return, recited elegiac poetry in mourning for the Mother of the Righteous, may God's peace and blessings be upon her, and then Hujjat al-Islam.

"The commanders discussed the Navy’s actions during operations across the various arenas, strengthening the partnership to maintain regional stability and the security of maritime routes, mutual coordination between the fleets, and technological knowledge-sharing," the IDF says in a statement. The 5th Fleet is headquartered in Bahrain and has been involved in low-level fighting against Iran in the Gulf
